name: Carrow & Fenn Dispatch Sling Pack
description:
Single-strap courier bag in waxed Senegalese cotton canvas, deep slate-blue with orange stress-stitching at the corners. The main compartment opens on a magnetic flap sealed with a secondary buckle clip; interior features a padded sleeve for data-slates and a rigid-walled cold pocket rated for biologic samples. Strap is reinforced with a flat aluminum rail that prevents slice-theft.

Scuffed at the base from constant contact with transit platforms, the bag develops a personal patina that regulars treat as a status marker in its own right.
functionality: Slash-resistant strap rail deters cut-and-run theft. Cold pocket maintains 4°C for up to six hours. Magnetic-plus-buckle dual closure rated for one-handed access. Fits standard data-slate and two document cylinders.
what_it_says: You move things for a living and you're better at it than anyone who questions you.
story_hooks: The cold pocket was sealed shut when the bag was purchased second-hand; the buyer hasn't decided yet whether to open it.
Carrow & Fenn stopped making the slate-blue colorway three years ago — anyone who recognizes it knows the wearer has been running the same route a long time.
The aluminum strap rail has a hollow section. Someone drilled it out before the original owner sold it.
